g.title: +AJB-X1-MCP
g.text: Use the upper terminal that is marked blue.
* Terminal 3U means land the wire on the upper deck of the block.
* Note that there are two of each block 3-6.
* (Terminals for field wiring marked BU for clarity.)

g.title: +AJB-X2-MCP
g.text: Use the terminal that is marked blue.
* Terminal 3U means land the wire on the upper deck of the block.
* Note that there are two of each block 3-6.
* (Terminals for field wiring marked BU for clarity.)

g.title: ACTUATOR-ANALOG
g.text: Pair 8 unused. Coil and insulate at both ends.
